item.title: Mickelson Pumpkin Patch in Petaluma — Fri Oct 23, 9:00 AM — Mickelson Pumpkin Patch 5495 Redwood Highway
item.description:
Celebrate fall at Mickelson Pumpkin Patch in Petaluma, just north of the Marin-Sonoma county line! This family-friendly pumpkin patch offers plenty of fall fun, including pumpkin picking, a hay maze and pyramid, tractor rides, a paintball gallery, and more. Shop for pumpkins, squash, and gourds, and enjoy food vendors and craft beer for the grown-ups. Admission: Monday-Friday: FREE Saturday-Sunday: $5 per person Additional fees apply for select activities. Please note: No outside food or dogs allowed. Directions: To get there, take Highway 101 north to the Petaluma Boulevard South/Kastania Road exit \(Exit 472A\). Turn right at the stoplight then turn right onto Petaluma Boulevard South. Follow the road south until you get to the pumpkin patch, which will be on your left.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch — Fri Oct 23, 10:00 AM — Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch 5300 Nicasio Valley Road
item.description:
Located in the small west Marin village of Nicasio, the farm is just west of the Nicasio Village Square right on Nicasio Valley Road. Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch is open seven days a week through Halloween from 10 am to 6 pm weekends and 10 am to 4 pm during the week, and it's always worth a visit. It's been a Marin County tradition for over 20 years! Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch offers a wide variety of pumpkins spread out in an expansive meadow on the farm. Pumpkin varieties ranged from your standard Halloween jack-o-lantern types to white ones, green Italian and Australian varieties, and flat European "Cinderella" style squash. The farmstand also offers of gourds, squash, and decorative cornstalks, apples, as well as drinks and snacks. Pumpkins range in price from $8 to $44. Admission is Free, Pumpkins are Priced Individually
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch — Sat Oct 24, 9:00 AM — Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch 5300 Nicasio Valley Road
item.description:
Celebrate fall at Nicasio Valley Pumpkin Patch, a favorite family tradition in Marin County for more than 20 years! Located in the scenic West Marin village of Nicasio, this family-friendly pumpkin patch offers a wide variety of pumpkins spread across a beautiful meadow, including classic jack-o'-lantern pumpkins, colorful specialty varieties, and Cinderella-style squash. Families can enjoy hayrides, farm animals, and live music on weekends. The farmstand also offers gourds, squash, decorative cornstalks, apples, drinks, and snacks. Food and refreshments are available on weekends. Admission and Parking: FREE! Pumpkins are priced individually, typically $8-$44. Some activities cost extra. Hours: Monday-Thursday: 10 am-4 pm Friday: 10 am-6 pm Saturday-Sunday: 9 am-6 pm Open daily through Halloween.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.title: Santa Rosa Pumpkin Patch — Sat Oct 24, 9:00 AM — Santa Rosa Pumpkin Patch 5157 Stony Point Road
item.description: Celebrate fall at the Santa Rosa Pumpkin Patch in Sonoma County! This family-friendly fall destination features eight acres of pumpkins, a giant seven-acre corn maze, and tons of fun activities for kids of all ages! Enjoy hay rides, kiddie corn mazes, a sunflower maze, a giant jumpy pillow, pedal trikes, a hay pyramid, tire swings, a corn play box, a petting zoo, face painting, and more. Pony rides are available on weekends, and food and treats are available for purchase. Admission: Pumpkin Patch Pass: $5 \(general admission, petting zoo, games, hay pyramid, and corn play box\) Farm Pass: $20 \(includes unlimited jumpy pillows and inflatables\) Farm Pass Plus\+: $30 \(includes corn maze, apple blasters, and a hayride or cow train ride\) Corn Maze Pass: $12 Children ages 2 and under: Free general admission Pumpkins and select attractions cost extra. Location: 5157 Stony Point Road, Santa Rosa, CA 95407 \(near Rohnert Park\). Hours: Monday-Thursday: 11 am-7 pm Friday: 11 am-9 pm Saturday

item.description:

Our family is happy and excited to welcome you to our local farm experience. This charming and quaint pumpkin patch is nestled in the Stafford Lake basin. Pick your own pumpkin in the pumpkin patch, wind your way through the toddler hay maze, climb the hay pyramid, launch mini pumpkins from the pumpkin slingshot and relax in the picnic area. Food available on weekends. Pick your own pumpkins for the fall. Toddler Hay Maze Hay Pyramid Mini Pumpkin Slingshot Food Available on Weekends Picnic Area School Field Trips Admission $5 Saturday & Sundays ages 2 and up. HALLOWINE WALK
Trick, Treat, & Taste in Yountville
Saturday, October 24, 2026 12:00 – 4:00 p.m. Washington St. | Yountville
Celebrate Halloween with a spirited afternoon in the heart of Yountville!
Join us for the inaugural Hallowine Walk: Trick, Treat & Taste in Yountville, where wine, Halloween, and small-town charm come together for a one-of-a-kind fall experience.
Your ticket includes a commemorative wine cup, event wristband, and tasting map. After checking in at Veterans Memorial Park, you’ll stroll through Yountville, visiting participating wineries, tasting rooms, restaurants, and local businesses while enjoying wine tastings, festive décor, seasonal surprises, and exclusive event-day offerings.
Costumes are encouraged, so gather your friends, dress in your Halloween best, and enjoy an unforgettable afternoon of wine, treats, and festive fun!
Ticket Includes:
Hallowine Walk cup
Wine tastings at participating locations
Event wristband and tasting map
Access to exclus

item.description:
Celebrate Día de los Muertos at Keller Estate with an evening honoring loved ones through music, food, culture, and community. Rooted in the traditional Mexican celebration of life and remembrance, the event invites guests to bring photos of departed family and friends to place on a communal altar, with frames provided. Festive activities, live music, and the atmosphere of a traditional Mexican pueblo will fill the plaza, while authentic Mexican cuisine paired with Keller Estate wines creates a warm and memorable gathering. This heartfelt celebration offers a beautiful opportunity to reflect, connect, and honor cherished memories together.
Source: North Bay Bohemian

item.description:
The Downtown Novato Community Farmers Market opens for its 2026 season tonight, Tuesday, May 5. The market takes place from 4 to 8 pm on Sherman Avenue between Grant Avenue & De Long Avenue \(see map below\). Come check out an abundance of fresh produce from local farms, fresh prepared foods from local vendors, crafts, and more. Each year the Novato Farmers Market grows and improves, and boasts an impressive array of some of the Bay Area's finest food purveyors, producers, farmers, and ranchers. The market also features activities for the kids and great live entertainment for you and your family to enjoy while you shop. The performer for opening day is Guerneville based band Inyan Kin. The Downtown Novato Community Farmers Market takes place everyTuesdays, May 5 through September 29 from 4pm - 8pm and then on Tuesdays, October 6 through October 27 from 4pm - 7pm.

item.description:
Cuentos con Ritmo (Stories with Rhythm)
Cuentos con Ritmo | Cuentos * Música * Movimiento
Presentado por Colors of Spanish
Cuentos con Ritmo es una oportunidad única semanal para niños de 1 a 5 años y sus familias, el cual aporta alegría, comprensión y aprecio por la lengua española a toda la comunidad. Durante Cuentos con Ritmo, los pequeños visitantes y sus familias participan de forma lúdica en historias interactivas con música y movimiento fortaleciendo nuestra diversa comunidad y entusiasmo por la lengua meta.
Cuentos con Ritmo es presentado por Guadalupe Tausch en colaboración con la organización que fundó, Colors of Spanish. Originaria del estado de Guanajuato en México, tiene una maestría en español con énfasis en la adquisición de una segunda lengua para la primera infancia y continúa sus estudios enfocada en la primera infancia especializándose en la adquisición de idiomas a través de la música/movimiento.
